name: 全屏贴合裸机感钢化膜款
description: 全屏贴合薄似裸机、高清高透、疏油层抗指纹、防爆防刮不易碎

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep navy #172447 and royal blue #2B4A8C diagonal geometric panels for hero and infographic screens, cool light grey #E6E8EE for macro and kit shots, pure white #FFFFFF for the compliant packshot
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool-neutral studio lighting with a soft rim light tracing the glass edge, controlled soft reflections on the glass, gentle violet screen glow, soft contact shadows; straight lines stay perfectly straight
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte cool light-grey panel #E6E8EE and seamless studio backdrops, no wood or fabric texture in studio shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type for short headlines and labels in #FFFFFF on dark panels or #2D2D2D on light panels, a small English category caption allowed as a positional element
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and thin outline rings, single glass-blue accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero presentation of the protector on a generic unbranded smartphone; consistent scale of phone and protector across the set; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
noDrift: no warped straight edges on glass or phone
no visible brand names on phone or accessories
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy background #172447, royal blue #2B4A8C, cool light grey #E6E8EE, pure white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D, pale glass-blue accent #7FA3E0 and soft violet screen glow #7B6BD9; cool-neutral tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif type; consistent diagonal geometric panel backgrounds and rounded info cards; thin-line icons with a single glass-blue accent; crisp studio product lighting with a soft rim light along the glass edge and controlled soft reflections; stable hero product angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; straight lines on the glass and the phone must stay perfectly straight; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warped straight edges.

shots.displayName: 全屏贴合裸机感主视觉
shots.intent: 开场一秒传达全屏贴合薄似裸机的核心卖点，赢得点击
shots.camera: low-angle slight 3/4 view looking slightly upward, {product} as a floating glass sheet just in front of a generic unbranded smartphone, both fully visible
shots.lighting: cool studio key from the upper right, soft rim light tracing the glass edge, soft violet screen glow, controlled soft reflection, soft contact shadow below
shots.background: deep navy #172447 with large diagonal geometric panels in royal blue #2B4A8C
shots.textZone: top-left headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF with a short subline 「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: Product hero of {product}, a tempered glass screen protector shown as a floating glass sheet just in front of a generic unbranded smartphone, photographed from a low-angle slight 3/4 view looking slightly upward, both fully visible, the phone and protector filling 60-70% of the frame as the anchor of one balanced composition. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Cool studio key light from the upper right with a soft rim light tracing the glass edge, a soft violet screen glow, controlled soft reflection on the glass, soft contact shadow below. Deep navy background #172447 with large diagonal geometric panels in royal blue #2B4A8C. The top-left of the frame carries a headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF with a short subline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #7FA3E0, completing the layout. shots.intent: 平台合规白底主图，轮廓干净锐利，搜索列表稳妥点击

shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product} installed edge-to-edge on a generic unbranded smartphone standing upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible, the product filling 60-70% of the frame so the composition reads complete. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding the phone. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial electronics e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand names, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no warped straight lines.

shots.intent: 放大意外跌落碎屏的风险，唤起保护需求

shots.lighting: left panel dimmer and colder; right panel clean cool studio light; identical direction on both panels
shots.background: cool light grey #E6E8EE on both panels, left panel slightly darkened
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

Left panel: the bare screen visibly shattered with fine crack lines after an accidental drop under dim cold light. Right panel: the same phone protected by {product}, screen intact and clear. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background cool light grey #E6E8EE on both panels, the left slightly darkened; the phone fills 60-70% of each panel so both sides read as full compositions. One short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D placed near the top of each panel. provenance.notes: 从 11 张手机钢化膜爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌（含参数页品牌/型号字样与会员二维码贴片）、英文角标、原文案与具体数字主张（厚度、曲面等级等不可验证信息一律走 {selling_point}/{callout} 文案槽由使用方填写，不发明认证与数据）；手机一律为通用无品牌占位，不出现任何手机品牌型号。
